description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for reading news articles, including web view display, text-to-speech functionality, and user interactions such as sharing, saving, and browsing articles.

classes.name: ReadArticleArgs
classes.description: A class encapsulating arguments for reading an article, primarily holding a NewsArticle object.

classes.name: ReadArticleScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a news article in a web view with text-to-speech and user interaction controls.

classes.name: _ReadArticleScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the web view, text-to-speech, and user interactions for ReadArticleScreen.

classes.name: _ListenMenuButton
classes.description: A StatelessWidget providing a popup menu for controlling speech playback, speed, and voice selection.

methods.name: _configureTts
methods.description: Configures the text-to-speech engine with language and speech rate.

methods.name: _handleMoreAction
methods.description: Handles user actions from the 'More' menu: sharing, saving, or browsing the article.

methods.name: _ttsText
methods.description: Generates the text to be spoken, appending a paywall message.

methods.name: _play
methods.description: Starts speech synthesis of the article content.

methods.name: _applyRateAndPlay
methods.description: Applies the selected speech rate and starts speaking.

methods.name: _applyVoiceAndPlay
methods.description: Sets the selected voice and starts speaking.
